name: Bilaspur
registryBasis: The supplied WUP point (22.0785316 N, 82.1514564 E) is the Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh settlement locus, matching Bilaspur District Administration’s own Bilaspur land-record pages, rather than the separate Bilaspur in Himachal Pradesh. The district page places its Land Record Office in the Bilaspur Collectorate and links Bhu-Naksha. Chhattisgarh’s Revenue Department identifies Bilaspur among ten urban areas whose aerial revenue survey was completed and whose new 1:500-scale urban records were described as being prepared. This supports local records and city-specific urban survey work, but the public polygon/schema and WUP-point village remain unverified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.

officialSources.observation: Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh District Administration describes Bhuiyan land-record viewing services and locates the Land Record Office in the Bilaspur Collectorate.
The local district administration describes Bhu-Naksha as a tool to view a Khasra map copy, links to the state viewer, and locates the Bilaspur Land Record Office in the Collectorate.

The Chhattisgarh Revenue Department names Bilaspur among ten urban areas with completed aerial survey and says preparation of new 1:500-scale urban revenue records was in progress. The page also describes cadastral-map scale conversion/georeferencing work as in progress; it does not establish an anonymous public polygon layer.
Hindi-language Bilaspur District page describes Khasra map copies through Bhu-Naksha and gives the Bilaspur Collectorate land-record office.
